subject: Request: temporary rate reconciliation for staggered model rollout
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Caroline Park <caroline@opsly.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary rate reconciliation for staggered model rollout

Team — looping you in on a request from Opsly. Short summary: Opsly is mid-pilot and just informed us that their internal engineering cannot complete the multi-model integration until late Nov due to a dependent infra project. They want a timeboxed commercial accommodation — effectively a temporary blended rate while they finish the integration so we don't lose momentum or the pilot window.

Key facts:
- Account: Opsly (Pilot started 2026-09-15)
- Impact: their usage pattern will be high for embeddings and short-chat traffic, but they can’t leverage our multi-model routing (which would materially reduce cost) until a feature in our roadmap ships in late Nov.
- Customer ask: a 10% temporary rate reconciliation for the pilot period (Oct 15 – Nov 30) or equivalent credit applied after GA of the routing feature.

Why this matters: Opsly is in a competitive procurement cycle with two vendors. If we don’t provide a short-term accommodation, they are likely to pause the pilot and reevaluate. Finance has asked for an exec-OK for anything beyond standard discounts.

What I need from you:
- Marissa: can you confirm commercial levers we can authorize from AE level vs what needs exec sign-off?
- Karthik/Laura (product & PM): can you confirm the expected ship date and whether a partial routing fallback is feasible earlier?
- All: recommended language if we offer a conditional credit (timeboxed, clawback if GA missed, usage floor).

Attachments: OPSLY_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (sow + pilot metrics), opsly_integration_notes.pdf (customer email thread).

Thanks — I’d like to get a go/no-go internal decision by COB Mon so we can respond before Opsly finishes vendor evaluations.

— Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Caroline Park <caroline@opsly.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate reconciliation for staggered model rollout

Alex — thanks for the summary. Short answer: AE authority covers up to a one-time credit equal to 5% of expected pilot spend. Anything above that or multi-period reconciliations need commercial exec approval. I can offer a limited goodwill credit today (<=5%) and propose exec review for the remainder.

Two practical asks for the response to Opsly:
1) If we provide a credit, make it timeboxed and conditional on them continuing the pilot (active account with minimum monthly usage).
2) We should request a short MOP (mutual action plan) milestone: confirmation of the integration timeline and a weekly sync.

I’ll draft a suggested message once we confirm product timing.

— Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Caroline Park <caroline@opsly.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate reconciliation for staggered model rollout

Alex / Marissa — quick product update and proposal.
- Ship date: Multi-model routing (v0) is on track for target 2026-11-24 (internal SLO +/- 2 weeks). There is a small chance of earlier cutover if we reallocate a prioritization slot, but that would delay a lower-priority telemetry task.
- Partial mitigation: we can enable a manual routing policy for Opsly earlier (interim config) that would approximate the cost benefits for short sequences; engineering estimates ~2 weeks of work to validate and ops to deploy. That could land around 2026-10-30 if we greenlight it.

Suggested commercial approach:
- Offer a one-time 5% pilot credit (Marissa can approve) immediately to show good faith.
- Commit to either: a) extend an additional 5% credit applied as reconciliation if we miss GA beyond 2026-11-24, or b) prioritize the manual routing mitigation to land by 2026-10-30 so credit is unnecessary.
- Condition: Opsly signs updated MAP milestones (attached) and agrees to weekly integration check-ins.

If you want a safer path that does not require exec time, choose the first option (5% now + conditional 5% if late). If sales wants to push for the manual mitigation route, we need exec sign-off to re-prioritize the engineering slot.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Caroline Park <caroline@opsly.com>, procurement@opsly.com
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary rate reconciliation for staggered model rollout

Team — I reviewed the ask and proposed options. Exec decision: approve the timeboxed approach to preserve momentum. Authorize the following (conditions below):
1) Immediate one-time 5% goodwill credit (Marissa to apply).
2) Contingent 5% reconciliation credit if we do not hit GA of multi-model routing by 2026-11-24. Finance to reconcile after GA; credit clawback if Opsly pauses pilot before GA.

Conditions:
- Opsly signs updated MAP by EOD Wed (2026-10-20) with the new milestones.
- Opsly commits to weekly integration syncs and provides an engineering point-of-contact.
- If Opsly requests anything beyond the two bullets above (longer term rate change, multi-month retroactive concession), we escalate to VP Commercial (Marissa will own escalation path).

Alex — please send Opsly the conditional note, include the MAP, and set expectations (we’ll prioritize manual mitigation only if product team confirms earlier slot is feasible). Marissa/Finance — confirm the credit mechanism and GL codes. Karthik/Laura — keep product priorities visible; escalate to me if manual mitigation is needed and has >1-week impact on other scheduled deliverables.

Thanks — Grace
VP, Customer Success & Growth (acting)
Redwood Inference
